slides.speaker_notes: Welcome to the technical architecture walkthrough of the Wumpus World autonomous simulation project. Today we will break down every file, class, method, and object interaction.

slides.title: High-Level Architecture & Separation of Concerns
column_1_bullets: Zero-Spaghetti Decoupling: UI logic is strictly isolated from core domain simulation.
Model-View Pattern: Core modules (world.py, agent.py, game.py) return plain data dictionaries.
Strategy Pattern: Agents are swappable via an abstract interface Agent.decide().
Replayability: World.clone() allows testing multiple agents on identical random seeds.
column_2_bullets: world.py: Grid bounds, hazard placement, percept calculation, ray-casting.
agent.py: Abstract Agent, DumbAgent, KnowledgeBase, A* Pathfinder, SmartAgent.
game.py: Turn resolution loop, action execution, scoring engine.
ui.py: ASCII board rendering, step telemetry, real-time dual file logging.
main.py: Interactive session loop, agent factory, replay management.
slides.speaker_notes: The primary design goal was readability and decoupling. If an engineer wants to study A* or logical inference, they only read agent.py without seeing any terminal escape codes or string formatting.

slides.title: File & Component Directory Map
slides.speaker_notes: Notice the clean import hierarchy: world.py has zero internal project dependencies. agent.py depends only on world constants. ui.py only receives plain dicts. game.py orchestrates all three.

slides.title: Turn Resolution Loop (Percept -> Act Cycle)
flow_steps: 1. Game calls World.get_percepts(agent.pos) -> generates stench, breeze, glitter, bump, scream flags.
2. Game calls Agent.decide(percepts, world) -> Agent evaluates state & returns (action, thought).
3. Game deducts action cost (-1) & applies kinematics/inventory mutation via Game._apply_action(action).
4. Game invokes ui.render_step_log() & ui.render_grid() with clean data snapshot.
slides.speaker_notes: Every turn strictly follows this 5-stage pipeline. The state of the world cannot be illegally altered by the agent; the agent can only propose an action string, which the Game engine evaluates and executes.

slides.title: world.py — Environment Mechanics & Physics
bullet_points: World.__init__(rows, cols, seed): Deterministic PRNG seed ensures reproducible layouts.
Agent Start: Always fixed at (0, 0) facing EAST (cell (0, 0) is guaranteed hazard-free).
Procedural Hazards: 1 Wumpus, 1 Gold, and scaled Pits: max(1, (rows * cols * 3) // 16).
World.get_percepts(): Checks orthogonal neighbors for living Wumpus (stench) or Pits (breeze); detects Gold on current cell (glitter).
World.resolve_arrow(from_pos, dir): Performs 1D ray-casting until hitting a boundary wall or Wumpus. Kills Wumpus upon direct impact.
World.clone(): Uses copy.deepcopy to snapshot exact layouts for replay comparisons.
slides.speaker_notes: World encapsulation is airtight. Ray-casting allows shooting arrows across multiple empty cells in cardinal directions.

slides.title: agent.py — Base Agent & DumbAgent
column_1_bullets: Inherits from abc.ABC with required @abstractmethod decide(percepts, world).
Tracks state: pos (r, c), direction (0-3), has_arrow, has_gold, is_alive.
Maintains visited set of tiles to avoid redundant work.
Encapsulates kinematic methods: do_turn_left(), do_turn_right(), get_forward_pos().
column_2_bullets: Solves the infinite 2-tile ping-pong defect of standard random agents.
Rule 1: If glitter perceived -> immediately returns GRAB.
Rule 2: Checks all 4 directions; strongly prioritizes unvisited neighbors.
Rule 3: If all adjacent tiles have been visited, executes a randomized rotation/movement escape maneuver.
slides.speaker_notes: Even the dumb baseline agent was engineered with visited-state awareness so it doesn't bounce endlessly between (0,0) and (0,1).

slides.title: agent.py — KnowledgeBase Deductive Reasoning
bullet_points: State Matrix: Tracks per-tile knowledge: UNKNOWN, SAFE, VISITED, POSSIBLE_PIT, POSSIBLE_WUMPUS, POSSIBLE_DANGER, CONFIRMED_PIT, CONFIRMED_WUMPUS.
Zero-Hazard Deduction: If a visited cell has NO stench and NO breeze, all orthogonal neighbors are guaranteed 100% SAFE.
Single-Candidate Elimination: If a stench or breeze is felt, and all candidate neighbors except one are proven safe, the remaining candidate is marked CONFIRMED.
Scream Resonance: Hearing a scream clears all Wumpus danger flags across the entire grid.
Iterative Propagation: _deduce() runs in a fixed-point loop until no further logical facts can be derived.
slides.speaker_notes: KnowledgeBase implements propositional logic inference without external SAT solvers, making it readable and educational for students.

slides.title: agent.py — SmartAgent & A* Path Planning
column_1_bullets: Computes optimal paths through known-safe tiles using heapq.
Manhattan distance heuristic: h(n) = |r1 - r2| + |c1 - c2|.
Dynamic walkable callback: agent queries self.kb.is_safe(p) to avoid hazardous tiles.
Path-to-Action translation: _plan_path_actions converts coordinate path into minimal turns and moves.
column_2_bullets: 1. Ingest new percepts & trigger KB deduction.
2. Grab gold immediately if glitter detected.
3. Execute queued action from current plan.
4. Shoot Wumpus if aligned on same row/col.
5. A* navigate to nearest unvisited safe tile.
6. Fallback: calculate risk scores & probe lowest-risk unknown tile.
slides.speaker_notes: SmartAgent doesn't just wander; it formulates multi-step action queues to cross the entire explored board safely to reach new frontiers.

slides.title: game.py — Turn Resolution, Rules & Scoring Engine
bullet_points: Action Scoring: Each physical action costs -1 point (step penalization promotes efficiency).
Wasting Arrow Penalty: Missing a shot deducts an additional -10 points.
Victory Bonus: Slaying the Wumpus or grabbing Gold awards +1000 points and ends game.
Catastrophic Penalties: Stepping into a Pit or onto a live Wumpus deducts -1000 points and triggers GAME OVER.
Timeout Guard: Maximum step limit (default 100) prevents infinite deadlocks.
Pure Orchestration: Game._apply_action() enforces world boundaries and validates all agent moves.
slides.speaker_notes: Scoring mirrors the classic Russell & Norvig textbook specification with the addition of the arrow victory mechanic.

slides.title: ui.py & main.py — Presentation & Session Management
column_1_bullets: ASCII/Unicode Table: Renders dynamic box borders, directional agent arrows, and hazard icons.
Fog of War: Unvisited tiles hidden with '?' during play; full reveal on game over.
Dual Output Engine: _print() writes to both terminal and result.txt simultaneously.
Sanitized Menu Prompts: Validates user input with fallback defaults.
column_2_bullets: Interactive CLI: Prompts for grid size and agent mode.
Factory Method: create_agent() instantiates Dumb or Smart agent.
Replay Loop: Allows re-running the exact same generated world using world.clone() to benchmark agents.
Guaranteed Teardown: Uses try...finally to ensure result.txt is cleanly flushed.
slides.speaker_notes: Dual logging allows non-interactive grading or artifact extraction: result.txt contains the complete trace of every move.
